relation: The finite hedgehog H_t: hedgehog_spike t is the subtype of ordered pairs (i, j) of I_t with i < j (Boolean strict-order witness), hedgehog_vertex t the sum carrier I_t + hedgehog_spike t, hedgehog_edge s the tagged triple [set inl i; inl j; inr s] of the spike s = (i, j), and hedgehog_edges t the image family of all spikes. Same carriers and MathComp finite subtype/sum/set/image structures as the X117 vocabulary, inferred by unfolding (no new instance); no positivity or rank guard (empty for t = 0, edgeless for t = 1). Ramsey numbers, forcing, copies and images and the GTMisc X87 Boolean ordered-edge lookup are separate.
summary: D7 turns X117 x117_spike, x117_vertex, x117_edge and x117_edges into aliases of the new public Hypergraph.foundations.hedgehog constructors hedgehog_spike, hedgehog_vertex, hedgehog_edge and hedgehog_edges: the same ordered-pair subtype, sum carrier, tagged triple and image family, with Type-valued and dependent signatures and finite inference unchanged. No positivity or rank guard; the client covers t = 0, 1, 2.

Frozen at the D6 pin in hypergraph-theory/theories/migration/hedgehog.v: the 4 raw constructors (calling one another only through HedgehogLegacy), the Ramsey chain (forcing at R and minimality) and the complete current row (keeping the live D5 forcing), and the complete D3+D4+D5+D7 Original chain and row over the raw constructors and D3's actual frozen image/copy/forcing (3 borrowed objects, historical role, alias IM). 8 owned + 3 borrowed mappings; 2 whole iff.

No older proof needed adaptation. The six older partial snapshots (Ramsey chain and row in D3 X117ImageLegacy, D4 X117CopyLegacy and D5 X117ForcingLegacy) stay byte-exact with notes, and reciprocal notes cover the new current snapshots. GTMisc.conjectures.X87.x87_edge, an ordered Boolean edge lookup, is a deferred distinct variant: untouched. Public client hypergraph-theory/theories/examples/hedgehog_hypergraphs.v.
